arxiv-1806-07010.title: On Schur Rings Over Infinite Groups
arxiv-1806-07010.creator: Nicholas Bastian, Jaden Brewer, Andrew Misseldine
arxiv-1806-07010.description: Abstract Schur rings are a type of subring of the group ring that is spanned by a partition of the group that meets certain conditions. Past literature has exclusively focused on the finite group case. This paper extends many classic results about Schur rings to the infinite groups, including Leung-Man’s classification of Schur rings over finite cyclic groups.

arxiv-2006-10165.title: Performance of the CMS Level-1 trigger in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2006-10165.description: Abstract At the start of Run 2 in 2015, the LHC delivered proton-proton collisions at a center-of-mass energy of 13 \TeV . During Run 2 (years 2015–2018) the LHC eventually reached a luminosity of 2.1 × 10 34 ​ \percms 2.

arxiv-2012-05933.title: Elastic and Fracture Behavior of Three-Dimensional Ply-to-Ply Angle Interlock Woven Composites: Through-Thickness, Size Effect, and Multiaxial Tests Journal: Composites Part C: Open Access
arxiv-2012-05933.creator: Weixin Li, Yao Qiao, Joel Fenner, Kyle Warren, Marco Salviato, Zdeněk P. Bažant, Gianluca Cusatis
arxiv-2012-05933.description: Abstract This work presents a comprehensive investigation of the elastic and fracture behavior of ply-to-ply angle interlock three-dimensional woven composites. The research investigated novel splitting and wedge-driven out-of-plane fracture tests to shed light on the tensile fracture behavior in the thickness direction and to provide estimates of the out-of-plane tensile strength and fracture energy.

arxiv-2105-00526.title: CDR Based Trajectories: Tentative for Filtering Ping-pong Handover
arxiv-2105-00526.creator: Joonas Lõmps, Artjom Lind, Amnir Hadachi
arxiv-2105-00526.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Joonas Lõmps, Artjom Lind, Amnir Hadachi. Call Detail Records (CDRs) coupled with the coverage area locations provide the operator with an incredible amount of information on its customers’ whereabouts and movement. Due to the non-static and overlapping nature of the antenna coverage area there commonly exist situations where cellphones geographically close to each other can be connected to different antennas due to handover rule - the operator hands over a certain cellphone to another antenna to spread the load between antennas.

arxiv-2109-06681.title: Leaf of Leaf Foliation and Beltrami Parametrization in d > 2 d>2 dimensional Gravity
arxiv-2109-06681.creator: Laurent Baulieu
arxiv-2109-06681.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Laurent Baulieu. This work shows the existence of a d > 2 d>2 dimensional covariant “Beltrami vielbein” that generalizes the d = 2 d=2 situation. Its definition relies on a sub-foliation Σ d − 1 A ​ D ​ M = Σ d − 3 × Σ 2 \Sigma^{ADM}_{d-1}=\Sigma_{d-3}\times\Sigma_{2} of the Arnowitt–Deser–Misner leaves of d d -dimensional Lorentzian manifolds ℳ d {\cal M}_{d} . Σ 2 \Sigma_{2} stands for the sub-foliating randomly varying Riemann surfaces in ℳ d {\cal M}_{d} .

arxiv-2112-14736.title: A definition of primary operators in J ​ T ¯ J\bar{T} - deformed CFTs
arxiv-2112-14736.creator: Monica Guica
arxiv-2112-14736.description: Abstract J ​ T ¯ J\bar{T} - deformed CFTs provide an interesting example of non-local, yet UV-complete two-dimensional QFTs that are entirely solvable. They have been recently shown to possess an infinite set of symmetries, which are a continuous deformation of the Virasoro-Kac-Moody symmetries of the seed CFT.

arxiv-2205-06840.title: IRB-NLP at SemEval-2022 Task 1: Exploring the Relationship Between Words and Their Semantic Representations
arxiv-2205-06840.creator: Damir Korenčić, Ivan Grubišić
arxiv-2205-06840.description: Abstract What is the relation between a word and its description, or a word and its embedding? Both descriptions and embeddings are semantic representations of words. But, what information from the original word remains in these representations? Or more importantly, which information about a word do these two representations share?

arxiv-2403-04428.title: Medium Assisted Low Energy Nuclear Fusion
arxiv-2403-04428.creator: Pankaj Jain 1, Harishyam Kumar 2
arxiv-2403-04428.description: Abstract We study the process of nuclear fusion at low energies in a medium using the second order time dependent perturbation theory. We consider a specific process which involves fusion of a low energy proton with a Nickel nucleus. The reaction proceeds in two steps or interactions.

arxiv-2506-05360.title: CarboNeXT and CarboFormer: Dual Semantic Segmentation Architectures for Detecting and Quantifying Carbon Dioxide Emissions Using Optical Gas Imaging
arxiv-2506-05360.creator: Taminul Islam, Toqi Tahamid Sarker, Mohamed G Embaby, Khaled R Ahmed, Amer AbuGhazaleh
arxiv-2506-05360.description: Abstract Carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) emissions are critical indicators of both environmental impact and various industrial processes, including livestock management. We introduce CarboNeXT, a semantic segmentation framework for Optical Gas Imaging (OGI), designed to detect and quantify CO 2 emissions across diverse applications.

arxiv-2507-05260.title: Beyond One Shot, Beyond One Perspective: Cross-View and Long-Horizon Distillation for Better LiDAR Representations
arxiv-2507-05260.creator: Xiang Xu, Lingdong Kong, Song Wang, Chuanwei Zhou, Qingshan Liu, [0.8ex] Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics National University of Singapore Zhejiang University
arxiv-2507-05260.description: Abstract LiDAR representation learning aims to extract rich structural and semantic information from large-scale, readily available datasets, reducing reliance on costly human annotations. However, existing LiDAR representation strategies often overlook the inherent spatiotemporal cues in LiDAR sequences, limiting their effectiveness.

arxiv-2601-13763.title: TransMode-LLM: Feature-Informed Natural Language Modeling with Domain-Enhanced Prompting for Travel Behavior Modeling
arxiv-2601-13763.creator: Meijing Zhang, Ying Xu*
arxiv-2601-13763.description: Abstract Understanding traveler behavior and accurately predicting travel mode choice are at the heart of transportation planning and policy-making. Traditional statistical and machine learning methods struggle to capture the complex contextual factors and interdependencies underlying individual decision-making processes. Large language models (LLMs) provide new pathways to address these gaps by leveraging their pre-trained knowledge about human decision-making.

pmc-11509088.title: Four-Dimensional Printing of Multi-Material Origami and Kirigami-Inspired Hydrogel Self-Folding Structures
pmc-11509088.creator: Divambal Appavoo, Nilab Azim, Maged Elshatoury, Dennis-Xavier Antony, Swaminathan Rajaraman, Lei Zhai, Franz E Weber
pmc-11509088.description: Four-dimensional printing refers to a process through which a 3D printed object transforms from one structure into another through the influence of an external energy input. Self-folding structures have been extensively studied to advance 3D printing technology into 4D using stimuli-responsive polymers.

pmc-11641333.title: Preparation and Characterization of Small-Size and Strong Antioxidant Nanocarriers to Enhance the Stability and Bioactivity of Curcumin
pmc-11641333.creator: Shanshan Tie, Yujin Yang, Jiawei Ding, Yanyan Li, Mengmeng Xue, Jianrui Sun, Fang Li, Qiuxia Fan, Ying Wu, Shaobin Gu, Francisca Hernández Garcia
pmc-11641333.description: The purpose of this study was to design nanocarriers with small-size and antioxidant properties for the effective encapsulation of curcumin. Here, procyanidins, vanillin, and amino acids were used to successfully prepare nanocarriers of a controllable size in the range of 328~953 nm and to endow antioxidant ability based on a one-step self-assembly method.

pmc-11674863.title: Effect of an Exercise Intervention Program on BMI and Distance Covered in the 6 Min Walking Test (6MWT) in Obese Children
pmc-11674863.creator: Ourania Papadopoulou, Evangelia Desli, Elisavet-Anna Chrysochoou, Christos Kogias, Vasileios Liakos, Athina Sopiadou, Petrina Vantsi, Ilias Kallistratos, Paris Iakovidis, Kiriaki Tsiroukidou, Elpis Hatziagorou
pmc-11674863.description: Background/Objectives: Childhood obesity appears to be an alarmingly growing global threat. Current evidence has shown that obesity can be successfully managed with interventions targeting movement skills, motor coordination and physical activity. However, data concerning physiotherapy practice are limited. We aimed to assess the impact of therapeutic exercise on the 6-minute walk test (6-MWT) in obese children and adolescents.

pmc-12591914.title: The utility of multi-b-value diffusion and arterial spin labelling magnetic resonance imaging in gliomas grading and prediction of isocitrate dehydrogenase status
pmc-12591914.creator: Tereza Kopřivová, Marek Dostál, Tomáš Jůza, Václav Vybíhal, Eduard Neuman, Petra Ovesná, Michal Kozubek, Miloš Keřkovský
pmc-12591914.description: BackgroundAlthough the possibilities for grading adult gliomas by conventional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are limited, several advanced techniques may be used in this respect. In this study, we evaluate the feasibility of multi-b-value diffusion MRI and arterial spin labelling (ASL) in grading gliomas and predicting their isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) molecular status.

pmc-12599312.title: Decoding cancer heterogeneity through super-enhancer landscapes: from subtype discovery to therapeutic opportunity
pmc-12599312.creator: Shuyang Cai, Zhenchang Wang, Xiao Sun, Hao Huang
pmc-12599312.description: Super-enhancers (SEs) are clusters of enhancers with potent regulatory capabilities. They play a crucial role in shaping cellular identity and driving the progression of various diseases, including cancer. SEs exhibit significant heterogeneity across different cell types and cancer subtypes. Analysis of SE landscapes can recapitulate existing classification systems and unveil novel SE-driven epigenetic subtypes.

pmc-12613777.title: Negligence in data recording during institutional birth: exploring health workers’ perspectives on the barriers and enablers of data documentation practices
pmc-12613777.creator: Biniam Kefiyalew Taye, Lemma Derseh Gezie, Asmamaw Atnafu, Shegaw Anagaw Mengiste, Jens Kaasbøll, Monika Knudsen Gullslett, Binyam Tilahun
pmc-12613777.description: BackgroundThe availability of well-documented records during labor and delivery is essential for monitoring childbirth and ensuring positive outcomes for mothers and newborns. However, recent research in northwestern Ethiopia shows that data recording during these critical periods is inadequately performed. This study explored the barriers and enablers of data recording practices during institutional childbirth in this region.

pmc-13050230.title: Evaluation of Recombinant Follicle-Stimulating Hormone (rFSH) Plus Recombinant Luteinizing Hormone (rLH) and rFSH Plus Human Menopausal Gonadotropin (HMG) Combination Therapies in Patients With Poor Ovarian Response Undergoing Ovarian Stimulation
pmc-13050230.creator: Ebru Ersoy, Muhammed Hanifi Bademkiran, Mustafa Demir, Duygu Turk
pmc-13050230.description: Objective: This study aimed to compare the clinical and laboratory outcomes of recombinant follicle-stimulating hormone (rFSH) plus recombinant luteinizing hormone (rLH) and rFSH plus human menopausal gonadotropin (HMG) combination therapies during controlled ovarian hyperstimulation (COH) in patients with poor ovarian response, with the live birth rate defined as the primary clinical endpoint.

pmc-13086848.title: Primary dysmenorrhea and associated factors among female adolescents in Jinka town, Southern Ethiopia, 2024
pmc-13086848.creator: Habtamu Wondmagegn, Kokobe Nigusu, Habtamu Esubalew Bezie, Biniyam Demisse Andarge, Sayih Mehari Degualem, Tsegazeab Ayele Meshesha, Edlework Wondmagegn Atlaw
pmc-13086848.description: Primary dysmenorrhea is a major public health problem and the commonest cause of morbidity in reproductive age women. It affects the quality of life of adolescent girls causing decreased academic performance and productivity. Therefore, this study aimed to determine the prevalence of Primary dysmenorrhea and associated factors among female adolescents in Jinka Town.

pmc-13150071.title: Transformer-Based Multiomics Study Identifies Important Role of Glycine, Serine, and Threonine Metabolism Pathway in Rheumatoid Arthritis Complicated by Anemia
pmc-13150071.creator: Jiaxin Huang, Yuanli Wei, Dongmei Wang, Zhuming Yin, Jianghua Chen, Congcong Jian, Xiaoting Zhu, Shilin Li, Jie Zhang, Tingting Wang, Caizhen Liu, Lingli Wei, Jing Gao, Jing Zhu, Qinghua Zou, Jianhong Wu, Fanxin Zeng
pmc-13150071.description: Highlights 1.This study used a transformer-based approach to intersecting multiomics signatures, systematically characterizing rheumatoid arthritis (RA) complicated by anemia (RA_ane) and emphasizing the pivotal role of the glycine, serine, and threonine metabolism pathway.2.Comparative analyses revealed that dysregulation of the glycine, serine, and threonine metabolism pathway is uniquely associated with RA_ane, distinguishing it from anemia in systemic lupus erythematosus or gout.3.

pmc-13236500.title: Editorial: Responses to chronic stress in vertebrate animals: from molecules to behavior
pmc-13236500.creator: Athanasios Samaras, Androniki Raftogianni, Marnix Gorissen
pmc-13236500.description: , and cognitive function. Understanding chronic stress responses across multiple levels of biological organization is therefore a central challenge in comparative physiology, neuroendocrinology, and animal welfare science. This Research Topic was conceived to bridge gaps in the definition of chronic stress, evaluate its indicators, and examine vertebrate responses at both inter- and intra-specific levels.

pmc-13261801.title: Effects of Oral Health and Functional Characteristics on Taste Sensitivity in Older Adults: Comparative Analysis Using Solution and Taste Strip Tests
pmc-13261801.creator: Hyo‐Jung Jung, Hye Jin Lee, Yehin Cho, Hyung‐Joon Ahn
pmc-13261801.description: BackgroundTaste sensitivity declines with age, adversely affecting dietary intake and quality of life. However, the effects of oral health and function on gustatory ability in older adults remain unclear.ObjectiveTo evaluate the relationship between oral health characteristics and taste sensitivity in older adults using solution and strip‐based gustatory tests.

pmc-13298874.title: High-urgency heart transplantation and outcome trade-offs: early post-transplant infection and mortality
pmc-13298874.creator: Kyu-Sun Lee, Darae Kim, Jin-Oh Choi, Hae-Young Lee, Myoung Soo Kim, Hyungseop Kim, Dong-Ju Choi, Sang Eun Lee, Seok-Min Kang, Soo Yong Lee, Hyun-Jai Cho, Cheol Kim, Cheol Kim, Jaewon Oh, Jin Joo Park, Min Ho Ju, Sung Ho Jung, Jung Ae Hong, Jeehoon Kang, Jeongsu Kim, Junho Hyun, Mi Hee Lim, Minjae Yo
pmc-13298874.description: Background and AimsTo evaluate differences in post-transplant outcomes by pre-transplant urgency status, focusing on early post-transplant infection and its contribution to mortality.MethodsWe retrospectively analysed 801 adult heart transplant recipients enrolled in the Korea Organ Transplant Registry (April 2014–December 2021). Recipients were classified as Status 0 (highest urgency; n = 287) and Status 1–3 (n = 514).
